label: PF Backlog 649
title: EDP: per-tenant authentication + hard per-tenant quota isolation for the data-plane service

brief.problem: EDP-10 per-tenant quotas are attribution only; edpsvc has one admin principal.
brief.what_adds: Per-tenant authentication/claims so quotas bind to the authenticated tenant.
brief.why_now: EDP-10 documents the limitation; hard per-tenant isolation needs a principal.
brief.success: A forged/rotated tenant key cannot reset another tenant's quota; cross-tenant is 403.

objective: Give go/edpsvc a real per-tenant principal so per-tenant quotas/concurrency are bound to the authenticated tenant instead of an advisory label, and cross-tenant admin traffic cannot reset another tenant's bucket.
acceptance_criteria: edpsvc accepts a per-tenant credential (or a signed tenant claim from a trusted gateway) and derives the tenant from the authenticated principal, never from a client-supplied X-Tenant-Id/query value.
Per-tenant quotas and concurrency are enforced against the authenticated tenant; rotating a header/query cannot reset or bypass the bucket, and a cross-tenant request is rejected 403.
Token issuance/rotation/expiry and the trusted-gateway trust boundary are documented, with tests for forged tenant claims, expired credentials and cross-tenant denial.
in_scope: EDP: per-tenant authentication + hard per-tenant quota isolation for the data-plane service
approach: EDP: per-tenant authentication + hard per-tenant quota isolation for the data-plane service
verification: Objective achieved: EDP: per-tenant authentication + hard per-tenant quota isolation for the data-plane service

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/service_catalog.py service auth + capacity hooks with per-tenant token verification and a hard quota guard; wire tenant scope from data-plane-threats.json; new Go middleware only where shipped data-plane logic demands it.
conflict_findings: BI-0041 concurrently edits core/capacity.py — coordinate quota source of truth
duplication_findings: BI-0041 overlaps tenant capacity on core/capacity.py — merge quota counting
BI-PF-1292 epic already claims tenant isolation — align, don't fork
analysis.rationale: Reuse service_catalog tenant identity + existing authz; add hard quota guard with fail-able tests. No new component.
assumptions: Service catalog already owns per-tenant identity
Existing authz boundary reusable at data-plane entry
